Remark
[Myers diameter bound from excess]

Source: petersen:page-0326 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-cheng-rigidity 1. ch7:7.5.22Show that if $\Ric \ge n-1$ then $\diam \le \pi $, by showing that if $|pq|>\pi $, then $e_{p,q}(x)=|px|+|xq|-|pq|$ has negative Laplacian at a local minimum.
